plan.title: Single-stage auction blocks partial mandatory T&C acceptance

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Configure a buy-side reverse auction for the full lot.
Apply the first available auction pricing template.
Add the requested product with quantity 10.
Set the first line item's delivery location.
Verify the requested plant location is shown in the sheet.

args.goal: in the Terms & Conditions drawer, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", enable "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory", click Done, and stop on the create screen showing both clauses with "Overridden by Mark all mandatory"

steps.note: Configure and verify the two mandatory clauses, which require on-screen interaction not represented by a dedicated domain step.
Invite the configured QA vendor for the vendor-portal submission.
Verify the event reached a published project page.
Open the separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's pricing sheet and its terms in the vendor portal.
Accept only the first mandatory clause.
Try to submit the 100 quote and require evidence that submission is blocked because the second mandatory clause remains unaccepted.
